title: System Identification of an Octocopter in Hover using Full-Harmonic Orthogonal Multisine Inputs
title_zh: 悬停状态下八旋翼飞行器的系统辨识：使用全谐波正交多正弦输入
abstract: A new method for multi-input flight maneuver design for system identification is presented. The method consists of injecting "full-harmonic" orthogonal multisine signals into the flight control system. Orthogonality is achieved by repeating maneuvers with changing multisine polarities. The multisines can contain the same frequency content, which can simplify frequency response estimation and allow for long flight maneuvers to be split into several shorter maneuvers while maintaining the same frequency resolution and minimum frequency. An input allocation scheme is presented that augments the multisines to size the vehicle response amplitude about a specific degree of freedom. The developed approach was demonstrated through flight testing of a small octocopter in near-hover conditions. The input allocation scheme was utilized successfully to increase excitation about the yaw axis. Electrical power, motor speed, and rigid-body dynamic models were identified and are shown to predict the vehicle and motor responses accurately. The models are parameterized primarily by rotor thrust and torque coefficients, making them suitable for analysis of aircraft flight dynamics and individual rotor aerodynamics. The results demonstrate that the near-hover flight dynamics can be modeled accurately by neglecting rotor hub moments, variations in rotor coefficients, gyroscopic moments in roll and pitch, and aerodynamic interaction effects.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种用于系统辨识的多输入飞行机动设计新方法。该方法包括向飞行控制系统注入“全谐波”正交多正弦信号。正交性通过改变多正弦信号的极性重复机动来实现。多正弦信号可以包含相同的频率成分，这可以简化频率响应估计，并允许将长飞行机动拆分为几个较短的机动，同时保持相同的频率分辨率和最小频率。提出了一种输入分配方案，该方案对多正弦信号进行增强，以围绕特定自由度调整飞行器响应幅度。所开发的方法通过小型八旋翼飞行器在近悬停条件下的飞行测试进行了演示。输入分配方案被成功用于增加偏航轴上的激励。辨识了电功率、电机转速和刚体动力学模型，并表明这些模型能准确预测飞行器和电机响应。模型主要由旋翼推力和扭矩系数参数化，使其适用于飞行器飞行动力学和单个旋翼空气动力学分析。结果表明，通过忽略旋翼毂力矩、旋翼系数变化、滚转和俯仰中的陀螺力矩以及气动干扰效应，可以准确地对近悬停飞行动力学进行建模。
tldr_zh: 提出全谐波正交多正弦输入方法，用于八旋翼悬停系统辨识。
cover_zh: 八旋翼悬停建模新突破｜正交多正弦输入让辨识更精准
